comments.author: Bucephalus355
comments.why: Strikingly real HD footage of 1993 NYC.
comments.text: Apparently VHS came out with an HD format in the early 1990’s. Here’s a sample clip from 1993 of NYC: [VIDEO] It’s amazing. It so...looks like today, but it’s not. I don’t know how to describe the realness of image quality that looks like it was filmed earlier this afternoon but is in fact over 20 years ago. Unsettling yet beautiful.

comments.author: nebula8804
comments.story: Quiet glimpses of the turn of the century NYC through an amateur’s camera
comments.why: HD footage of NYC in 1993 from a JVC demo tape.
comments.text: Here is some HD footage of NYC in 1993...close enough: [VIDEO] This was way before HD was a common tech (this was during VHS's height right?). This was a demonstration tape of JVC's commercial HD cameras played back on D-VHS which never really took off (Digital HD video on VHS) Some interesting things of note: Clear images of the Twin Towers The guy wearing an SS t-shirt trying to block the camera at 1:42 Did people have differing dental standards back then? Seems like something has changed in the culture(3:58) Camel advertisement at 4:12 And finally....Ponytail guy making a quick peek at 0:58 :)
